end.summary:
Named polygons by counting sides, including quadrilateral, pentagon, hexagon and octagon.
Recognised triangles and polygons when rotated, tilted or uneven; used side and corner counting.
Described triangles using equal sides and identified triangle angle types.
Teach-back was not yet passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Veer practised naming polygons, recognising shapes in different positions, and describing triangles by equal sides and angle types. Counting sides and corners worked well, including for tilted and uneven shapes. Veer was unsure about folding a square along a diagonal into triangles, and this was not revisited before the lesson ended. At home, ask Veer to find and name polygons in everyday objects by counting their sides.
